import os
from pathlib import Path

home = Path.home()
paths = []

# Linux
paths += [home/".electrum", home/".config"/"electrum"]
# macOS
paths += [home/"Library"/"Application Support"/"Electrum"]
# Windows (best-effort)
appdata = os.environ.get("APPDATA")
localappdata = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA")
if appdata:
    paths += [Path(appdata)/"Electrum"]
if localappdata:
    paths += [Path(localappdata)/"Electrum"]
paths += [home/"AppData"/"Roaming"/"Electrum", home/"AppData"/"Local"/"Electrum"]

# Also check common XDG dirs if set
xdg_config = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
xdg_data = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME")
if xdg_config:
    paths += [Path(xdg_config)/"electrum"]
if xdg_data:
    paths += [Path(xdg_data)/"electrum"]

seen=set()
existing=[]
for p in paths:
    p = p.expanduser()
    if str(p) in seen: continue
    seen.add(str(p))
    if p.exists() and p.is_dir():
        existing.append(p)

print("Checked standard Electrum data dirs:")
for p in paths:
    print(" -", p)
print()
if not existing:
    print("No Electrum wallet directories found at standard paths on this host.")
else:
    print("Found existing Electrum directories:")
    for d in existing:
        print(" -", d)
        # list likely wallet subdirs/files
        for sub in ["wallets","testnet","regtest","config","electrum.conf"]:
            sp = d/sub
            if sp.exists():
                print("    *", sp, "(dir)" if sp.is_dir() else "(file)")
